messages:
tara: noticed p95 in the latency dashboard spiked for /generate after the routing tweak; p99 dropped slightly. looks like merged quantiles are hiding per-route shifts. anyone else?

leo: yea, this pattern usually means fallback route moved a chunk of midtail mass. merged tdigest exaggerates the change. we should show route split by default when multiple routes exist.

janet (console): agree. small UX change: add a tiny "routes: N" badge on the sparkline; hover expands to per-route p50/p95/p99 with counts. also add an 'approx' label when tdigest is used.

metrics-bot: Quick check: /generate counts last 30m -> main: 42,100, fallback: 4,300, aux: 210. merged tdigest p95 = 240ms, merged exact p95 (sampled) = 205ms.

leo: thanks bot. action: tara please open a ticket to (1) add routes badge + hover, (2) toggle per-route view on heavy-fallback, (3) add tooltip note about approx quantiles. I'll prototype backend flagging for bimodal endpoints.

tara: will do. tagging @sre for visibility. :thumbsup:
